name: qr-code
description: SVG QR code generator (byte mode, versions 1–40) from text input with configurable size and error correction

changes.note: Versions 1–40, a visible failure, and the ISO quiet zone as padding. The encoder stopped at version 10 (about 213 bytes at ECL M); it now carries ISO/IEC 18004 Table 9 for every version, computes the codeword count and the Annex E alignment centres, and writes the version word from version 7 up — 2953 bytes at L, 2331 at M, 1663 at Q, 1273 at H. A value it cannot encode used to leave an empty box and a console warning: the root now takes data-state="error" and dispatches a bubbling faqir:error { message, value, ecl } (the warning stays), and data-state is "ready" or "empty" otherwise, as barcode's is. The modules are drawn flush — the viewBox is the symbol, so the ink meets the SVG's content box — and the quiet zone is CSS padding on the SVG, --qr-quiet modules (default 4, as ISO asks; it was 2), inside the same 80/128/200 px box, painted in --color-bg. A layout that aligns the ink with a caption or column edge sets --qr-quiet: 0 or pulls the box out by the padding. The code itself draws smaller inside the unchanged box.

Nested components keep their own parts. The stylesheet reached the svg and caption with descendant selectors, so a component nested inside with parts of the same name took this one's styles. Both are the root's children. Every part rule is now a child chain from the root, with the hops in :where(), so no rule changes specificity. No change for markup that follows the template.

svg.description: Generated SVG QR code (created by controller). Drawn flush (the viewBox is the symbol, one unit per module); the quiet zone is its padding, and it carries the module count as the --qr-modules custom property

caption.description: Optional text label below the QR code

empty.description: No data-value to encode; nothing is drawn

error.description: The value could not be encoded (longer than version 40 holds at this ECL); nothing is drawn and faqir:error was dispatched

value.description: Text or URL to encode in the QR code (data-value attribute)

ecl.description: Error correction level: L (7%), M (15%), Q (25%), H (30%)

--qr-quiet.description: Quiet zone in modules (custom property), drawn as the SVG's padding inside its size. ISO/IEC 18004 asks for 4; set 0 where the page already leaves light space round the code, or to align the ink with a caption or column edge

faqir:error.detail: { message: string, value: string, ecl: string }
faqir:error.description: Fires on the root when the value cannot be encoded — longer than version 40 holds at this ECL (2953 bytes at L, 2331 at M, 1663 at Q, 1273 at H). The root has data-state="error" and no SVG.

required_attrs: aria-label describing the QR code content

templates.html_with_caption: {caption}
